messages:
Tara: Heads-up — Marlin Systems returned the RFP with last-minute asks: one-page capability matrix, regional throughput by EU/US/APAC, explicit burst pricing formula, and POC acceptance criteria. They want the packet by Tue COB.
Ibrahim: Copy. For regional throughput we should show per-region sustained QPS @512 tokens and a burst headroom number. Propose columns: Hosted / Dedicated (reserved pool) / Carveout pool (dedicated per-customer).
Sofia: Legal flagged data residency + peering: they want assurance requests stay in-region and an option for zonal peering. We can say "regional routing and data residency controls available; Private can be pinned to customer VPC". I'll attach the residency appendix.
Grant: Draft perf numbers (conservative): Hosted: 40 QPS sustained per region (p95 ~220ms); Dedicated (4xA100 equiv): 280 QPS sustained, absorb 10x short bursts with autoscale; Carveout: depends on commit, provide benchmark ranges.
Tara: Billing: propose burst_fee = base_rate * (burst_QPS/commit_QPS - 1) * minutes * burst_multiplier; set burst_multiplier=2.5. Add numeric example. Also include an egress cap note.
Ibrahim: POC acceptance criteria: 1) ingest 100k embeddings with <2% error rate, 2) end-to-end p95 latency under committed target for two consecutive runs, 3) infra failover test (regional fallback) passes. Short and measurable.
Sofia: Security asks: SOC2 snapshot + KMS rotation (default 90d, customer-configurable in Private), HSM vendors supported: Thales, AWS CloudHSM. Legal says "compatible with FIPS-validated HSMs" only.
BenchBot: bench-job marlin-4795550000 started on ephemeral cluster; results ETA ~45m.
Tara: Action items: Grant update matrix with regional columns and carveout row; Ibrahim draft the numeric pricing example and POC success table; Sofia drop residency appendix and SOC2 excerpt; I will assemble and submit. Please drop assets in /sales/marlin by 3pm PT Monday. :thumbsup:
